name: Desktop Development Profile
description: Native Windows (WinUI), Apple macOS (SwiftUI/AppKit), Flutter Desktop, Tauri, and secure Electron applications

optional_specialists.trigger: Windows native application (WinUI 3, Windows App SDK, Fluent Design)
Apple macOS native application (SwiftUI, AppKit, Apple HIG)
Tauri desktop application with Rust backend commands
Electron application requiring contextIsolation and IPC hardening
Desktop security review (IPC, WebViews, local filesystem access)
Native UI/UX critique and accessibility audit

routing_flow: 1. Detect Framework: Exactly one of WinUI, macOS, Flutter Desktop, Tauri, or Electron
2. Superpowers Engineering Process: Brainstorming and detailed implementation plan
3. Primary Platform Authority: Load official platform framework skill
4. Interaction Craft: Apply Emil Kowalski interaction principles in native idioms
5. Security Isolation: Audit IPC, filesystem, and WebView boundaries via OWASP
6. Native UI Critique: Impeccable native keyboard, scaling, and contrast review
7. Release Verification: Packaging, signing, entitlements, and runtime smoke testing
release_gate: Native build passes cleanly without compilation warnings
Keyboard navigation and shortcuts function correctly across all views
High DPI scaling and dynamic window resizing operate smoothly
High Contrast / dark mode switches without visual glitches
IPC boundaries strictly validate inputs and reject unauthorized commands
App sandbox and entitlements are minimal and correctly configured
Packaging and code-signing workflows succeed deterministically
